definitions.gloss: small blessing; a slightly good fortune (on an omikuji)
definitions.explanation: A fortune level on an {御神籤|おみくじ} indicating a small amount of good luck. It generally ranks below {中吉|ちゅうきち} (middle blessing).

examples.japanese: おみくじ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小吉|しょうきち}だった。
examples.english: The omikuji was a small blessing.

examples.japanese: {小吉|しょうきち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{前向|まえむ}き→前向き：10073_maemuki⟧だった。
examples.english: Even though it was a small blessing, the words written on it were positive.

examples.japanese: {小吉|しょうきち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{幸運|こううん}→幸運：02725_kouun⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A small blessing isn't great fortune, but it carries the meaning that things can improve depending on your efforts.

notes:
A modestly good fortune on an おみくじ, ranking below ⟦{中吉|ちゅうきち}→中吉：29072_chuukichi⟧. The ordering of fortunes varies by shrine, and at some shrines {小吉|しょうきち} ranks above ⟦{末吉|すえきち}→末吉：29074_suekichi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小吉|しょうきち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw a small blessing
- おみくじ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{小吉|しょうきち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to get a small blessing on a fortune slip
